subject: pharmacology
title: NTEP Regimens, DOTS and Latent Tuberculosis Treatment

steps.tx: The **NTEP regimen** (India's National TB Elimination Programme, descendant of RNTCP) delivers standardised weight banded fixed dose combinations free through public systems: daily 2HRZE then 4HRE (ethambutol continued in continuation in current Indian guidance) for drug susceptible disease, with Nikshay registration, nutritional support payments, and drug resistant pathways feeding BPaL era regimens. Knowing the national programme's current shape is pharmacology in uniform for Indian examinations and practice alike.
steps.say: NTEP standardises free, weight banded, daily therapy with registration and nutritional support attached.

vis.alt: DOTS tuberculosis treatment categories and regimen illustration
vis.caption: Standardised tuberculosis regimen categories delivered through programme structures like NTEP. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.tx: **DOTS** (directly observed therapy, short course) began as witnessed ingestion and matured into patient centric adherence ecosystems: community health worker observation, family DOT, digital adherence technologies (pill boxes, video observation, 99DOTS style phone confirmation), because the evidence favours support over surveillance theatre. Its five original pillars (political commitment, quality microscopy and now molecular diagnostics, drug supply, standardised treatment, recording) remain programme grammar worldwide.
steps.say: DOTS grew from watching swallows to supporting completion; observation is the least important letter now.

right.title: Modern adherence ecosystem
points: Video observed and digital adherence options

steps.tx: **Weight banding replaces** milligram arithmetic in programme prescribing: fixed dose combination tablets in adult bands (for example 25 to 34, 35 to 49, 50 to 64, 65 plus kg bands under NTEP with defined tablet counts) and paediatric dispersible formulations, reducing dispensing error and simplifying supply chains. Private sector prescriptions that ignore bands and split combinations invite the dosing errors programmes were built to abolish.
steps.say: Bands, not calculators: programme tablets turn weight into a tablet count anyone can verify.

nodes.label: Patient weighed at initiation and monthly
Weight band assigns fixed dose tablet count
Full course strips dispensed and recorded

steps.tx: **Latent TB** management inside programmes follows risk arithmetic: test (tuberculin skin or IGRA) where it changes management, treat household contacts (especially under five years, where preventive therapy follows active disease exclusion clinically), people with HIV, and pre immunosuppression cohorts, with regimens from the isoniazid lesson chosen by interactions and completion probability. India's programme expansion of TB preventive treatment to household contacts is the current policy frontier.
steps.say: Preventive therapy follows risk and exclusion of active disease, children under five first in line.

left.title: Priority for preventive therapy
points: Pre anti TNF, transplant and dialysis patients
Silicosis and other high risk lungs

right.title: Before prescribing
points: Symptom screen and chest imaging exclude activity

steps.tx: **Extrapulmonary and special** site regimens extend durations by anatomy: tuberculous meningitis nine to twelve months with adjunctive corticosteroids (mortality benefit proven), bone and joint nine to twelve by response, pericardial steroids debated by HIV status, and drug penetration arguments (rifampicin and isoniazid enter CSF; ethambutol and aminoglycosides poorly) shaping substitutions. The six month pulmonary sentence is a minimum, not a reflex, at these sites.
steps.say: Meninges and bone buy longer courses and steroids; six months is the floor, not the law.

nodes.label: Site defined: meningeal, bone, pericardial, pulmonary
Duration set: 6, 9 or 12 months by site
Adjunctive steroids for meningitis (and defined niches)
Response review with imaging and cultures

steps.tx: **Programme pharmacovigilance converts** individual adverse effects into system learning: hepatotoxicity, rash, visual and neuropathy reporting through Nikshay, drug resistant referral pathways to district centres, and private sector notification mandates because half of India's tuberculosis is first treated outside the programme. Every private prescription for tuberculosis that escapes notification delays contact tracing and resistance surveillance, a civic dimension of prescribing examinations increasingly acknowledge.
steps.say: Notify, report adverse effects, refer resistance: the programme is the patient's second prescription.

right.title: Private practice integration
points: Free programme drugs versus private purchase counselling
Standards for TB Care in India alignment
Nikshay entry regardless of treatment site

steps.tx: **Treatment interruptions are** managed by calendar rules rather than blame: intensive phase interruptions restart or extend by gap length, continuation interruptions count missed doses toward extension thresholds, and default retrieval systems (calls, visits, digital nudges) activate within days. Pharmacologically, interrupted therapy is resistance selection pressure with a timetable, which is why programmes count doses, not months, as the true currency of completion.
steps.say: Count doses, retrieve early, extend by rule; interruption is resistance pressure with paperwork.

nodes.label: Phase extended or restarted by gap rules
Dose count completed and outcome assigned

steps.tx: **The endgame vocabulary** closes the tuberculosis arc: elimination targets measured in incidence per lakh, preventive therapy scale up, molecular universal drug susceptibility testing, and shorter regimens (four month rifapentine moxifloxacin for susceptible disease in current guidance) compressing what six months meant. Each advance is a previous lesson's pharmacology (rifamycin potency, quinolone sterilisation, adherence science) arriving as policy.
steps.say: Shorter, molecular and preventive: elimination policy is this module's pharmacology at population scale.

left.title: Programme frontier
points: Universal rapid molecular testing with resistance
Four month susceptible regimens entering guidance

right.title: Clinician's part
points: Prescribe programme shapes, private or public
Report, notify and refer by pathway
Counsel completion as cure's active ingredient
Suspect resistance early and test for it
